hero.title: The Glass Fortress Manifesto
hero.subtitle: A decentralised, blockchain-protected legal evidence platform — documenting the suppression of safety data, experimentation without informed consent, and violations of the Nuremberg Code during the Covid-19 crisis.

mission.title: The Mission
mission.p1: We are building a multi-dimensional legal case against public health authorities who suppressed safety data, conducted medical experimentation without informed consent, and misled regulators and the public — during the COVID-19 crisis. The claim is not mere negligence: some of these acts carry potential criminal liability.
mission.p2: Our platform lets citizens, doctors, and whistleblowers submit evidence with full anonymity. The AI classifies, summarises, and tiers each submission.
mission.item1: Suppression of safety data — adverse events not disclosed to the public
mission.item3: Medical experimentation without informed consent — violation of the Nuremberg Code

blockchain.title: The Blockchain Guarantee
blockchain.p1: We do NOT store files on the blockchain — only a digital fingerprint: a SHA-256 hash of the file. Every piece of evidence receives an immutable timestamp on the Arbitrum network.
blockchain.p2: The cryptographic timestamp proves in court that a document existed and was unchanged from that moment — defeating any deepfake or forgery claim.
blockchain.footer: The record is independent and immutable — no single party can delete it.

vault.title: The Dark Vault — Your Privacy
vault.p1: The blockchain is fully anonymous. Your name is never recorded there. The file itself is not stored.
vault.p2: If you choose to leave contact details, they are AES-256 encrypted in the 'Dark Vault' — a physically isolated database with no public internet access.
vault.item3: Legal access only, with your consent

trust.heading: Why Trust Us
trust.badge1: Open source — every line of code is auditable
trust.badge3: Full anonymity — no account, no registration
trust.badge4: AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data
trust.badge5: No central server — decentralised and resilient

home.heroTitle: Concealment, Coercion, and the Question of Criminal Liability — The Covid Case
home.heroSubtitle: We are building an evidence-based legal case documenting the suppression of safety data, experimentation on citizens without informed consent, and violations of foundational bioethics principles. Every piece of evidence submitted brings us closer to the question of criminal accountability.
home.warBoardSubtitle: Each card is a separate legal argument. Click any case to see what we are looking for and submit evidence anonymously.
home.door1Body: If you have internal documents, reports, correspondence, or any information related to Covid-19 policy — submit it anonymously. No account. No IP logging. No identity stored.
home.door2Body: Our research team works via MCP + Claude. Access is invite-only to maintain the quality and integrity of the case. Apply to join.

researchers.title: Join the Research Team
researchers.subtitle: Researchers build the legal case via MCP tools. Your workspace is any MCP-compatible client — Claude Desktop, Cursor, or the OpenAI and Gemini desktop apps — connected directly to our evidence vault. The internal AI agents (analysis, synthesis, FOIA drafting) always run on Claude regardless of which client you use.
researchers.step1Body: Research access is invite-only. Each researcher is issued an MCP write token that gates all write operations. Read access — browsing evidence, theses, and forensic scans — is always public.
researchers.step2Body: Configure any MCP-compatible client — Claude Desktop, Cursor, or the OpenAI and Gemini desktop apps — with our MCP server endpoint. From that point the client has direct access to the evidence vault, forensic diff engine, and thesis builder.
researchers.step3Body: Create thesis drafts from vault evidence, run forensic scans on government URLs, track research sessions, generate FOIA letters — all through natural language. Note: the analysis agents that run inside the platform (devil's advocate, thesis synthesis) always call Claude — this is independent of your MCP client.
researchers.contactBody: Send an email with a brief description of your research background and area of focus. We will review and issue a write token if there is a good fit.
researchers.publicNote: All evidence, theses, and forensic scans are permanently public and verifiable. Only write operations require an MCP write token.
